text_block_list.name: VR Umalator
text_block_list.text: Powering on. Please input data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep...

text_block_list.name: VR Umalator
text_block_list.text:
Commencing simulation. Prix de l'Arc de

Triomphe. The Paddock.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El! Sorry for keeping you waiting! What's
this
thing you wanted to discuss?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Spe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Can I ask you for something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... So, El Condor Pasa is acting as
your
coach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yup. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Get better for me, so you can board a
plane when
the time comes. You want to
see me race in
person, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well... Heheh. That sure gives me
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, come and watch me at the

Takarazuka Kinen too. Skip rehab if you
have to.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Teach, you've lived for more than
another year
since then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's why I know you're going to live
even
longer. You'll be able to watch me
run in the Prix
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Make sure... you live your life to the
fullest too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to being able to
show you the
world, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We reserve the track's latest time slot of
the day.
After checking with the
maintenance staff, we
soak the turf with
a hose—just enough to avoid
affecting
the surface the following day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Another one of your crazy ideas, huh.
This is
pretty sludgy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see. The Arc tends to get a lot of
rain,
after all.
choice_data_list: できる限りの重バ場を用意してみたんだ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So this training is to prepare me for
dealing with
poor track conditions on
the day of the race?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Yeah, it feels pretty sloppy, all
right.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is good enough considering what
we're
capable of.
choice_data_list: でも『凱旋門賞』の芝と感覚が全然違うよな
でも『凱旋門賞』の芝と感覚が全然違うよね

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I mean... there's only so much we can do.
choice_data_list: ……けど“充分”でいいのか？
……けど“充分”でいいのかな

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We'll make the best out of what we've
got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I are filling out the

registration form for the Prix de l'Arc de

Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not an exaggeration to say this race
could
change Nakayama Festa's life.
choice_data_list: （……『凱旋門賞』は大きなレースだ）

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
What? You're dropping out?! You finally
reached
the Arc, which should've been
the beginning of a
whole new chapter in
your racing career!

text_block_list.name: Arc Racer
text_block_list.text:
This is a place of aspiration and
longing—a fitting
location to set the
final chapter.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It all ends once you've lost your fighting
spirit!
Afterwards, you'll just get
trampled under the
weight of the strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think much of what Sirius
Symboli told me
then. But now...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey. Heeey. Earth to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Please wait!
choice_data_list: ご、ごめん！あとは提出するだけだな！
ご、ごめん！あとは提出するだけだね！

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? El?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? We can handle
submitting the
forms ourse—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: One year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Give me one year of Nakayama's time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you enter the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe as
you are now, you won't take
first place!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong. At present, you're
strong
enough to finish with a good
result.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But a good result is the best you'll get. You won't be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hold up, El. What the hell?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't cut it on the world stage. I
know better
than anyone just how high
the bar is!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're not ready! You haven't even truly

experienced a world-class race yet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But I'll see to it that you get that
experience.
choice_data_list: 世界レベルのレース……？

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me and Spe. We've got you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We've taken on all manner of legends
from
overseas. Give us the time to get
back to our
former glory.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trust me. One year will be over in the
blink of an
eye. I really, really mean it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So please, give us a little more of your
time! I
swear you won't regret it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Our strengths, our frustrations, our
hopes,
everything—let us entrust it all to
you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Por favor.
choice_data_list: つまり、君たちとレースを……？
つまり、貴方たちとレースを……？

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I just know that Nakayama is capable of
reaching
that place beyond our dreams.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to run against Spe in the
Takarazuka
Kinen and me in the Japan
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous! We can't change our
schedule
on such short notice.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you understand me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After everything you've done, you've
realized it,
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(There's no way to train for this on the
academy's
turf.)
choice_data_list: ……見えたもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This has been the twentieth or so
request I've had
declined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more I learn, the more distant our
goals seem
to become.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is good enough considering what
we're
capable of.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You won't know what's truly important
without
the necessary experience and
knowledge.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But you get it now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
None of it has been enough—your
technique,
your experience, your
connections, not even your
time spent
preparing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No... I only started to realize it after El
Condor
Pasa began coaching us.
choice_data_list: （……わかっていた）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But something I feared kept me from
openly
acknowledging it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No... It has to be now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I don't do it now, Teach might not
make it! She
might not survive until next
year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So, it doesn't matter if you lose then?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The gap between us and the
international stage is
immense! No
manner of excuses is going to
change
that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know what you want! I know you want
to deliver
the greatest hope to
everyone! I know you want
to win at all
costs!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But still... Still...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El is genuinely placing her faith in you.
That's why
she's doing all this to help
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She'll sometimes give you the facts
straight
without any sugar coating. When
she does, please
take her words into
consideration. It won't be out
of spite,
but rather hope.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see you off with a smile...
and to tell
you that you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa's legs are shaking ever so
slightly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But when it became clear to me, I just
couldn't let
it slide!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list: ……そこまで言わせてしまって、ごめん
……そこまで言わせてしまって、ごめんね

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The final decision isn't mine to make.
That
responsibility falls on you.
choice_data_list: ありがとう、言い出しづらいことだったのに

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I just want you to succeed. I know how
the world
works, so let's spend one more
year preparing
together.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be a symbol of hope, I
want you
to be capable of it first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Again. The decision is yours to make.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: ああ。……ナカヤマ、話そう
うん。……ナカヤマ、話そう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How long do we have until the newly
risen moon
once more descends below
the horizon?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A whole year... is too long.
choice_data_list: 正直、君はどう思っている？
正直、貴方はどう思っている？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Last year showed us just how quickly the
human
body can fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even though hope is holding things
together right
now, will Teach be able to
hang on for another
year?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I... I... I just—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
When the end eventually comes... I want
her to
feel like I gave her something
worth waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I string Teach along another year just
for better
odds... Even all the hope in
the world might not...
it might not be
enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get it. I know full well who she's doing
this all
for—and why. Since classic year,
Nakayama has
been fighting so hard to
give her mentor hope.
choice_data_list: ……そうか
……そう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when we first found out the stakes,

Nakayama knew she was taking on a big
gamble.
Now, though... she can't afford
to treat this like a
game.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet, still...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please... help Festa live her life to the
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't keep looking away and
pretending not to
notice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I can still improve, but it's not like
my
chances right now are frickin' zero!
choice_data_list: ……でもこのままでもいけないよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And even if we postpone the attempt for
next
year, that won't bring our chances
to one
hundred.
choice_data_list: ああ、そうだと思う
うん、そうだと思う

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But to take on the Arc at the level we
are now...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: 負けた時『仕方なかった』って思うよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Nakayama is making the
gamble
because she thinks it's now or
never—not because
she believes in her
chances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to say that she'll do the best
she can with
the time she has, but deep
down...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: あの人のためだったって、人のせいにして

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Nakayama's gonna do this, it has to be
of her
own volition, weighing on her own
shoulders.
choice_data_list: それでいいのか？
それでいいの？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gambling away someone else's chips
doesn't carry
the same responsibility as
putting her own on the
table.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: 俺は俺たちの賭けだったって言いたい
私は私たちの賭けだったって言いたい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we're gonna do this, we've gotta throw out any doubts now. And then whatever happens happens. No regrets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...
choice_data_list: どの道を選ぶのか決めよう、自分たちで

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...With her condition, the odds of me
getting to
show her a win next year are
even lower than now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I decide that I'd rather bet on my
chances this
year, would you still
support me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt, the kind soul lying in that
hospital bed
would agree.
choice_data_list: 結果的に君が選んだ勝負なら、構わない
結果的に貴方が選んだ勝負なら、構わない

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: それが地獄に続く一本道でも、一緒に行くよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return to my office alone and put the
Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe registration
documents up on
the white board.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Until she's fully certain of her choice.
